name: Continuous Electron Beam Accelerator Facility
notes: kind is recorded as `linac`; CEBAF is technically a recirculating (racetrack) superconducting linac, which ACCELERATOR_KINDS does not have a dedicated value for.

beam_energy.note: Original design energy was 6 GeV; the 12 GeV Upgrade was dedicated 2 May 2018 (src:jlab-wikipedia).
beam_energy.quote: The CEBAF energy was recently upgraded from 6 GeV to 12 GeV, and an additional experimental area was added to support the highest-energy experiments.
